definitions.explanation: The player who scores the most points or goals in a league or tournament. A title used primarily in team sports like soccer and basketball.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得点王|とくてんおう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧だ。
examples.english: Who is this season's top scorer?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{得点王|とくてんおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: He won the scoring title for two consecutive years.

examples.japanese: {得点王|とくてんおう}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{節|せつ}→節：19359_setsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The race for the scoring title continues until the final match day.

notes:
USAGE:
Used mainly in soccer (J⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧), basketball, and other team sports. The suffix ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧ (king/champion) is commonly attached to categories to denote the best performer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得点王|とくてんおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧ (to win the scoring title)
- {得点王|とくてんおう}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ (scoring title race)
- {得点王|とくてんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to claim the scoring title)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新人王|しんじんおう}→新人王：18556_shinjinou⟧: rookie of the year — the best newcomer award in a league or sport
